description: A Viet Nam energy-system project republishes a 2016 transmission-network and substation map originally linked to Energydata.info. Zenodo lists a public 120 KB ZIP under CC BY 4.0. The named resource could provide grid line and node locations when constructing a spatial electricity-network or outage-exposure simulation. It is a historical map, not a verified present-day operational grid or a set of line ratings. The landing page does not specify coordinate system, voltage levels, whether the ZIP holds vectors or an image, topology quality, or the number of substations. Its Energydata.info source has separate provenance and should be checked before redistribution or use as an authoritative asset inventory. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this specific 2016 map. The ZIP was not downloaded, so geometry, file format and completeness remain unverified. This draft represents the map as a potential network input, not a model ready for load-flow calculation.
name: Transmission network and Substations map of Vietnam (2016)
